data_cdn_meta.name: schemas/test-catalog-v60.json
data_cdn_meta.description: JSON Schema for test_catalog.json. v70: id-based tests (a stable `id` keys each test so later tests can chain off an earlier test's extracted outputs, e.g. send -> read -> delete). Body is validated post-_meta-strip. Per-test shape is permissive here (additionalProperties:true) and enforced rigorously by the runtime test runner (parseTestCatalog).
changelog: 2.0.0 (2026-06-08): v70 id-based shape — tests carry `id` + `commit`; top-level `integration_id` moved to _meta; per-test additionalProperties:true for chaining fields.

title: Spec 70 test_catalog.json
description: Self-fixturing test chain for an integration. Each test has a stable id, an action + flavor, a commit flag, an expected outcome, and inputs; later tests may reference earlier tests' extracted outputs by id.

tests.description: Ordered tests the runner executes in sequence, threading extracted outputs between them by id.

id.description: Stable id for this test (id-based catalogs); later tests reference its extracted outputs (e.g. {{send.message_id}}).

name.description: Human-readable test name (legacy name-based catalogs). FOLLOW-UP: normalize all catalogs to the id-based shape.

action.description: Verb name from the manifest's actions/<verb>.yaml.

flavor.description: Flavor name from the action's flavors[] (browser, oauth_api, session_api, mcp, …).

commit.description: Whether the runner commits the write (true) or exercises the discard/cancel path (false).

expected_outcome.description: Outcome action name (matches one of the entries in the action's outcomes[] / the result.outcome value).

inputs.description: Inputs to pass to the action at execution time. May reference earlier tests' outputs.

expected_data.description: Optional. Expected shape of the outcome's extracted data, for stronger assertions.

skip_reason.description: If set, this test is skipped. Records WHY.
